requirements: R1: Fix GitHub PR synchronization to correctly handle PRs that are closed without a merge, ensuring corresponding tasks are not erroneously marked as done.

slices.title: Patch PR synchronization logic for unmerged closures
slices.jtbd: When implementing the PR synchronization fix for this epic, I want to properly map the GitHub 'closed without merge' state, so that the internal task status correctly reflects the reality of the repository.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task with a GitHub PR that is closed but not merged
When the system synchronizes the PR status
Then the internal task status is NOT marked as 'done'
And integration tests must cover this unmerged closure scenario to verify correctness.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease false-positive task completion rate for closed unmerged PRs to 0%
